summary: The shop is experiencing a high error rate because the product-catalog service is down (exited/unhealthy), causing dependent services like recommendation, checkout, and frontend to fail when requesting product data.

root_cause.cause: The product-catalog service container has exited and is in an unhealthy state, leading to gRPC UNAVAILABLE errors (status 14) in all dependent services.

evidence.why: The product-catalog container has exited and is unhealthy, making it unavailable to other services.
The recommendation service is failing because it cannot connect to the product-catalog service (gRPC status 14 UNAVAILABLE).

evidence.quote: "error_message":"connection error: desc = \"transport: Error while dialing: dial tcp 172.23.0.24:3550: connect: no route to host\"","operation":"oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct","origin_service":"checkout"
evidence.why: The checkout service is also failing to connect to the product-catalog service.

proposed_action.reason: The product-catalog service has exited and is unhealthy, causing cascading failures in recommendation, checkout, and frontend services. Restarting it should restore functionality.

timeline.event: High error rate detected on the shop.
Investigation shows recommendation, checkout, and frontend services are failing.
Traces confirm failures are due to product-catalog being unreachable (gRPC status 14).
Container health check confirms product-catalog has exited.

alert: Alert fired: error rate above threshold on the shop
